# se.hadi — Hadi Moustafa

> Web developer and digital marketer in Lebanon. Websites and systems that bring you customers, built, run and marketed by one person. Main offer: subscriber billing and collections software for local internet providers and other subscription businesses (generators, water, cable, gyms, schools), replacing Excel and paper. Secondary offer: website + marketing launch for small businesses. Free 20-minute call, fixed price in writing, reply within 24 hours. Contact is WhatsApp-first.

## Services

- [Billing & collections system](https://hadimoustafa.dev/services/billing-system): billing software for internet providers and subscription businesses in Lebanon (main offer)
- [Websites & web apps](https://hadimoustafa.dev/services/engineering): websites for small businesses, with an admin panel
- [Digital marketing](https://hadimoustafa.dev/services/marketing): Instagram, Facebook and TikTok ads with honest reporting
- [Support & maintenance](https://hadimoustafa.dev/services/support)
- [Social media growth](https://hadimoustafa.dev/services/growth)

## Case studies

- [ISP.NET](https://hadimoustafa.dev/work/isp-net): billing and collections system for a local internet provider; 236 active subscribers, 71% of a month's billing settled, one-tap Arabic WhatsApp reminders, offline collector view
- [Zack Production](https://hadimoustafa.dev/work/zack-production): website + admin panel for a Beirut photography and film studio, built in about three weeks
- [Tech store: 98 Instagram profile visits for $6.83](https://hadimoustafa.dev/work/hadi-tech-store): Meta campaign for a technology store, objective Instagram profile visits; 9,659 people reached, 10,241 impressions, about $0.07 per visit
- [Test campaign: what $68 of ads buys](https://hadimoustafa.dev/work/meta-tiktok-ad-campaign): Meta + TikTok test for a fashion brand in Africa; 218 profile visits at $0.13, 6,092 engagements at about $0.01, 88,701 impressions
